label: Vitruvian two pose proportion context
adaptation_note: Two original-proportion pose overviews at a common uniform scale, each followed by four enlarged boundary-contact windows. Bodies and reference frames retain source ratios. Details have a separately stated scale and continuation edges. Simplified centreline limbs and closed terminal codes are retained, not presented as realistic anatomy.
acceptance_requirement: Keep the original body/reference proportions in the main panels. Do not stretch limbs or enlarge body widths to gain clearance; mark detail scale separately.

frames.title: Square pose with reference boundary
frames.teaching_key: The source simplified square pose and its reference boundary at 0.115 native pins per source unit, with a uniform scale in both axes. Same scale for both main poses: no widened torso or stretched limb. Closed hand/foot end codes are too small for anatomy here and are enlarged in the following four contact windows. This is a proportional context model, not a reproduction of a detailed anatomical drawing.

frames.title: Square left hand contact detail
frames.teaching_key: Enlarged source-coordinate window, square pose, left hand. Same source geometry as the main panel, at 0.78 pins per source unit; no limb reshaping. The small closed end carrier touches its reference boundary at the source endpoint. Limb and reference boundary continue beyond the window. The carrier is the source hand/foot code, not fingers or toes.

source_window.rectangle_role: centred layout focus, not exact clipping rectangle
